The closest match is the paper by Zichao Wei on the computational complexity of structural generalization, which formalizes structural generalization and argues that learning it with a pure Transformer is limited by a TC^0 ceiling versus an NC^1 lower bound [1]. A separate Wei paper presents a system for structural generalization on SLOG without hand-written rules, using a neural cellular automaton with a discrete bottleneck and reporting strong benchmark results [2].

If you meant “Wei” in the sense of complexity of structural generalization, [1] is the direct match; if you meant empirical structural generalization systems, [2] is the relevant paper.
